gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-bpmf-huninn: Bpmf Huninn draws its letters like a single-weight outline, with a wide channel into every bowl. Bellota Text handles the headline with open, unshaded curves, which gives the modern body below a distinctive, commanding lead.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-cairo: Distinctive round bowls with no swelling or tapering lead in Bellota Text, while Cairo opens a wide channel into every bowl. Round display drama meets modern restraint, which is the whole appeal.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-cantarell: Bellota Text leads with open curves and no calligraphic shading. Cantarell sits underneath with c tips pulled well apart and arches matching their stems, so the sans text feels approachable.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-didact-gothic: Contemporary Didact Gothic gives every stroke the same visual weight, so nothing snags on a closed bowl. And Bellota Text makes its case in large, brief headings, where its open curves show.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-dotgothic16: DotGothic16 reads in a tube-like thickness that holds through every bend. Bellota Text suits large headings, where its open, unshaded curves carry a commanding, distinctive voice of their own.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-doto: Bellota Text brings the commanding, distinctive punch, with open curves and no calligraphic shading. Doto does the quiet work, with wide margins of space around each glyph and generous mouths on the round letters.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-encode-sans-sc: Bellota Text leaves its curves open and drops any calligraphic shading. Encode Sans SC, with a shallow terminal curl and wide gap, makes the split between display and body the pair's best trait.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-encode-sans-semi-: Open, unshaded curves with no calligraphic shading mark Bellota Text out at once. Encode Sans Semi Condensed, a modern sans-serif with an open counter on the s, keeps paragraphs moving smoothly.

Commanding open curves headline Bellota Text, free of any calligraphic shading that would guide the eye. Encode Sans Semi Expanded leaves its rounded letters open too, and that shared openness is the pair's real strength.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-exo-2: Exo 2 lets plenty of daylight into its curves, clean and professional in tone. And Bellota Text leads with open, unshaded shapes, so paragraphs under it keep moving along.
